 ‘Harry Kane is a great goalscorer but Lamine Yamal is the best player’ - Barcelona’s star uncle hits out at Ballon d’Or award
 ‘If you like football, you go to see Lamine.’
 by Barca Blaugranes Oct 28, 2026, 3:00 AM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 BARCELONA, SPAIN - OCTOBER 25: Lamine Yamal of FC Barcelona looks on during the Spanish League, LaLiga EA Sports, football match between FC Barcelona and Real Madrid CF at Spotify Camp Nou on October 25, 2026, in Barcelona, Spain. (Photo By Dennis Agyeman/Europa Press via Getty Images) Europa Press via Getty Images Lamine Yamal’s uncle feels the Barcelona superstar deserved to win the 2026 Ballon d’Or over Bayern star Harry Kane. 
 The Barcelona teenager actually finished third in the rankings, with Kylian Mbappe in second, but Abdul Abdellaoui says his nephew is the best player on the planet.
 “My nephew was amazing, he was the best player in the world, everyone knows it,” he told El Larguero .
 “If you like football, you go to see Lamine, not Harry Kane. Harry Kane is a great goalscorer but Lamine is the best player who shines on the pitch.
 ”Lamine is very young, he’s 19, he’ll win more, but Harry only has three days of football left and we’re giving him the ball.”
 “He’s won a World Cup, La Liga, and the Super Cup. He plays very well. He’s had an incredible season. He scores goals that nobody else scores. Passes, assists, you name it.”
 Yamal did take home the Kopa Trophy yet again and is being tipped to go on and win the Ballon d’Or in the future by Barcelona president Joan Laporta.
 “I am convinced that he will win the Ballon d’Or, I don’t know when, but he deserved it,” he said, per Mundo Deportivo.
 ”In my view, he did enough to win the Ballon d’Or, but the voters decided the matter this way, and that must be accepted in a sporting spirit. I hope this will be a motivation for him on a personal level, and I am sure it will be. All his teammates will help him get over this disappointment quickly.”
